primary: late raw-frame MUSIQ: P3 FR minus P1 FR, averaged within seed then prompt
noise_target: fixed per-event absolute K/V innovation norm recorded from the paired quantized FR trajectory; no control-state amplitude recalibration
noise_nonfinite: record secondary instability outcome and retain partial tensors; full-sample noise quality contrasts undefined if any paired control fails; primary TF/FR must remain finite
multiplicity: two-sided exact paired sign-flip p values, Holm across two bit widths
primary_ci: 97.5 percent prompt-cluster percentile bootstrap; both seeds retained together
